title: Vortex SMP
body:
**Vortex SMP** is a French community-driven Minecraft survival server focused on an enhanced vanilla experience. With over 400 unique players, it offers a lively and active community where you can build, explore, and compete.

Take part in regular events, engage in PvP, and earn in-game rewards through a voting system. The server is strictly **non pay-to-win**, meaning everything is obtainable through gameplay only.

Enjoy frequent updates, responsive support via Discord, and a stable 24/7 server designed for long-term survival adventures.
